name: Consumption statement allocation
description: Allocation of a consumption statement amount to an accounting account and an apportionment.

condo_id.label: Condominium
condo_id.help: Select the condominium that owns the statement, account and apportionment.

consumption_statement_id.label: Consumption statement
consumption_statement_id.description: Consumption statement the allocation relates to.
consumption_statement_id.help: Only statements from the selected condominium are available.

account_id.label: Accounting account
account_id.description: Accounting account the allocated amount relates to.
account_id.help: Only accounts from the selected condominium are available.

apportionment_id.label: Apportionment
apportionment_id.description: Apportionment used to distribute the allocated amount.
apportionment_id.help: Only apportionments from the selected condominium are available.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Amount allocated to the accounting account and apportionment.
amount.help: Enter the amount of the consumption statement assigned to this allocation.

form.default.name: Consumption statement allocation
form.default.description: Edit an allocation of a consumption statement amount.

list.default.name: Consumption statement allocations
list.default.description: Allocations of consumption statement amounts by accounting account and apportionment.
